snippet.title: Pizza Time Explosion - Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Pizza Time Explosion is out now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1198600/Pizza_Time_Explosion/

Pizza Time Explosion is a fast-paced arcade style game in which you, a pizza slice, must collect billions of pizza slices in order to reach critical pizza mass and create the pizza time explosion!

Pledge $5 to my patreon to receive this game for free alongside a special art and assets package! https://www.patreon.com/fluttergirly

#PizzaTimeExplosion
